title: Unlock your account or reset your password
excerpt: Accounts lock after 5 failed sign-in attempts. Most can be unlocked in two minutes without a ticket.
body:
1. Go to the staff portal and choose "Forgot password".
2. Enter your staff email and approve the prompt on your phone.
3. Wait 5 minutes before signing in to the policy admin system — it syncs on a delay.

Still locked after 15 minutes? Send an Access request to IT with the exact error message.

title: Connecting to the VPN from home or a branch
excerpt: Install the client from Software Centre and sign in with your staff email.
body:
1. Open Software Centre and install "miLife VPN".
2. Sign in with your staff email and approve the phone prompt.
3. Choose the Achimota HQ gateway, or Kumasi if you are in the Ashanti region.

If it drops every few minutes, restart your router first, then send a Network & VPN ticket with your branch name.

title: Requesting laptops and equipment for new staff
excerpt: IT prepares devices once HR confirms the start date and Finance approves the budget.
body:
1. HR sends a Hardware ticket to IT with the start date and role.
2. IT attaches specs and a quote, then forwards the ticket to Finance for budget approval.
3. Once approved, devices are ready within 5 working days.

Allow at least two weeks before the start date.

title: Refunding a duplicate MoMo or Telecel Cash deduction
excerpt: Finance refunds confirmed duplicate debits within 48 hours. Send both transaction IDs.
body:
1. Confirm both transaction IDs with the customer or the telco statement.
2. Send a Refund request to Finance with the policy number and both IDs.
3. Finance reverses one deduction and Customer Service updates the customer.

IT only needs to be involved if more than 10 customers report the same issue on the same day.

title: Agent commission statement schedule
excerpt: Statements close on the 25th; commissions are paid on the 5th of the next month.
body:
Statements close on the 25th of each month and are published by the 28th. Commissions are paid on the 5th.

Missing commission? Send a Commission query to Finance within 30 days with the agent code and policy numbers.

title: Death claim documents checklist
excerpt: What Claims needs before a death claim can be verified and paid.
body:
• Death certificate
• Burial permit
• Claimant Ghana Card
• Policy schedule
• Bank or MoMo details for payment

Complete claims are verified within 2 working days, then sent to Finance for payout release.

title: Correcting your leave balance
excerpt: Balances sync nightly from payroll. Raise a ticket if it has not updated after 24 hours.
body:
1. Check that your leave form was approved by your head of department.
2. Wait 24 hours for the nightly payroll sync.
3. If it is still wrong, send a Leave & payroll ticket to HR and attach the approved form.

title: Reporting power, generator or air conditioning faults
excerpt: Server room and branch-wide outages are always Urgent.
body:
For server room or branch-wide power loss, send an Urgent Power & generator ticket — the Facilities duty officer is paged straight away.

For air conditioning, office repairs and printers, use the matching category. Printers are leased, so Facilities logs faults with the vendor.

title: Ordering campaign artwork and branded materials
excerpt: Allow 5 working days for artwork and 10 for printed materials.
body: Send a Campaign artwork ticket to Marketing with the product (miKids, miTribute, miLegacy…), audience, sizes and deadline. Attach any copy already approved by Compliance.

title: Policy document dispatch timelines
excerpt: New policy documents are printed within 3 working days and dispatched by courier.
body:
Documents are printed within 3 working days of a policy being issued. Branch dispatches go out every Tuesday and Friday.

If documents are more than 7 days late, send a Printing & dispatch ticket to Operations with the policy numbers.
